title: Allows device cards to rearrange with the window width
goal: combines scalable container width and media queries to stack cards in narrow screens and side by side in wide screens.
summary: device reservation page uses a fixed width. The content of the small window will overflow, and the space of the large window will not be used well.
tasks: Let the width of .equipment-grid change with .equipment-stage and always fill this area.
When the viewport is less than 680px, let the two cards occupy one line each.
Starting from 680px, arrange the two cards into two columns of equal width, leaving a 12px gap and making both columns fall within the area.

example.note: The ordering menu is first displayed in one column. After reaching the break point, the two 1fr tracks bisect the remaining width after deducting the gap.

hint: When both columns are set to 50%, the two columns have occupied the entire width, and if the gap is added, they will overflow. Use fr to leave space for intervals.
